name: Gemstone Fractures
description: Fragments the image into crystalline shards with physical light transmission, each shard rotated about its own centre. Golden rutile silk needles glint inside the shards, a six-rayed star asterism in every shard glides toward the pointer (the light), and pleochroic body tint shifts between violet-blue and honey with each shard's crystal orientation. Internal fractures scatter light, purity varies per cell, and IOR drives refraction. Bass brightens the stars, treble makes the needles sparkle.

params.name: Fracture Density
params.description: Internal fractures: 0 = pure crystal, 1 = heavily fractured
